hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.description: Find all the answers to your questions about SchoolHub. Our support team is also available to help you.

support.title: Need help?
support.description: Our support team is available to answer all your questions.

createAccount.question: How do I create an account on SchoolHub?
createAccount.answer: Click 'Get Started' in the top right, then follow the registration steps. You will receive a confirmation email to activate your account. Administrators can also create accounts for students and teachers at their institution.

addChildren.question: How do I add multiple children to a parent account?
addChildren.answer: In your parent space, go to 'My Children' then click 'Add a Child'. Enter the code provided by your child's institution. You can follow multiple children enrolled in different institutions.

changePassword.question: How do I change my password?
changePassword.answer: Access your profile by clicking on your avatar, then 'Security Settings' and 'Change Password'. You will receive a confirmation email to validate the change.

publishCourses.question: How do teachers publish courses?
publishCourses.answer: Teachers access their educational space, create a new course, add resources (documents, videos, links) and publish it. Students receive an automatic notification.

askQuestions.question: Can students ask questions about courses?
askQuestions.answer: Yes, each course has a discussion space where students can ask questions. Teachers respond and answers are visible to the entire class.

trackProgress.question: How do I track student progress?
trackProgress.answer: A dedicated dashboard shows grades, assignments submitted, time spent on each module, and progress statistics for each student.

dataProtection.question: How are student data protected?
dataProtection.answer: All data is encrypted with SSL/TLS. We comply with GDPR and regulations on the protection of minors. Data is hosted in Europe with daily backups.

accessLevels.question: What are the different access levels?
accessLevels.answer: There are 4 main roles: Administrator (full access), Teacher (educational management), Student (access to courses and grades), Parent (child monitoring). Each role has specific permissions.

parentControl.question: Can I control what parents see?
parentControl.answer: Yes, teachers and administrators can configure information visibility: detailed grades or averages only, public or private comments, etc.

plans.question: What pricing plans are available?
plans.answer: We offer 3 plans: Essential (up to 300 students), Professional (up to 1000 students) with advanced analytics, and Enterprise (unlimited) with dedicated support. Contact us for a custom quote.

trial.question: Is there a free trial period?
trial.answer: Yes, all plans include 30 days of free trial with no commitment. No credit card required for the trial period.

billing.question: How does billing work?
billing.answer: Annual or monthly billing at your choice. Payment by credit card, bank transfer or check. 15% discount for annual commitment. Invoices available in the admin space.
